text:
Marina: heads-up: were seeing a small but consistent hole in decision logs for requests that include header-driven overrides. ~0.4% of requests have no decision_log entry even though the route matched. anyone recall recent sampler/header changes?

Ashok: which sampling layer? global sampler or per-route?

Marina: global sampler, sampling=1% in prod. the odd thing: the missing entries correlate with requests that have X-Route-Override (and some custom gateway headers).

Zach: can you paste a repro curl + a trace id? could be normalization ordering.

Marina: repro and trace: trace=01f3a2b9
```

curl -i \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "X-Route-Override: api-v2" \
  -H "X-Client-Env: qa" \
  "https://gateway.redwood/api/generate?model=gpt-neo"
```

Marina: this one shows route matched (we can see the route action in the gateway logs) but no decision log in the decision_store for that trace id.

Lisa: I remember we merged a header normalization patch that canonicalizes header names earlier in the pipeline. if sampler runs before we apply that canonicalization, it might be evaluating a different header map.

Ashok: right now the runtimes sampler reads the raw header map that arrives from the API ingress. header-override resolution happens later and may mutate the header keys when we canonicalize. so if a client sends "x-route-override" (lowercase) vs "X-Route-Override" (mixed), behavior differs.

Marina: confirmed: sending lowercase header vs mixed-case changes whether the decision_log gets emitted. the sampling rules key off route id which only exists after the override is resolved.

dev-bot: deploy report: feature routing-header-normalize rolled out to prod-us-west on 2026-04-02.

Zach: ideas for remediation?

Lisa: options:
- move sampler to run after override resolution (bigger refactor)
- make sampler consult the post-normalized header map when header-driven rules are present (small change)
- adjust sampler header matching to canonicalize names on read (minimal)

Ashok: short-term: implement sampler fallback to the normalized header map if route-id is missing. I can send a small patch and unit tests.

Zach: add e2e that sends mixed-case and lowercase variants and asserts decision_log exists for decision_log:true routes. also add a sampling telemetry counter (sampler.mismatch_missing_route_id) so we can monitor.

Marina: Ill collect examples and upload a failing traces list and link to the dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/routing/decision-log-coverage?env=prod-us-west

Lisa: also add a debug config to force decision logs for a tiny shard (0.1%) so we can get full traces while we fix. :thumbsup:

Ashok: PR 4123 opened. touches sampler and header util. unit tests included. marking as high.

Marina: local verification: after the change, mixed-case/lowercase both produce decision_log entries in staging.

svc-tracing-bot: canary capture: decision_log=true for traces: [01f3a2b9, 01f3a2c0, 01f3a2dd]

Zach: rollout plan: canary 1% for 1 hour, watch decision-log-coverage and sampler.mismatch_missing_route_id.

Lisa: ops note: if mismatch counter spikes, rollback immediately.

Marina: follow-ups: add a line in routing docs about header-casing/sampler order, and add the e2e to nightly.

Ashok: assigning follow-ups to Ashok/Lisa. will close thread when PR merged.
